generate_joint_space_min_jerk: generate joint space min jerk waypoints between a start and goal joint configuration over time
generate_cartesian_space_min_jerk: generate cartesian space min jerk waypoints between a start and goal pose with rotation and translation
generate_position_min_jerk: generate position min jerk waypoints between a start and goal 3D position over time
